Our engineers are working through it but it looks like a 2–3 week delay before we can run the PoC end-to-end.

We have legal/ procurement questions pending — Alex (copied) will handle the paperwork once we agree on scope. I attached the integration logs that show the webhook errors. Can you flag this as urgent? Our board wants a decision before the end of next week.

Appreciate any help,

— Sana

On Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 10:08 AM marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding NovuOps' request. Their staging is blocked by a webhook change on the partner side (logs attached). Can David confirm the root cause and a rough ETA for our side of the fix?

I looked through the logs. The error shows a schema mismatch during the initial handshake; NovuOps' partner started sending an extra meta header under "x-ext" which causes our parser to drop the payload. Fix is straightforward: add a tolerant parser branch and a guarded validation step. Estimated dev + QA: ~10 workdays (2 engineers) to have reliable end-to-end tests on our staging. If they can run our suggested backfill script, it reduces effort to ~5 workdays.

Given the timeline, 30 days seems tight but workable — I'd recommend we offer a 45-day window to give them slack (their vendor could introduce more churn). For sandbox tokens: 50k would be fine for basic validation, but if they want to run full-scale end-to-end tests including load runs, 75k is safer. Happy to sync with NovuOps engineering on the backfill script and run a joint debugging call.

— David
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
